description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Habit Tracker app, defining app theme, navigation, screens (Onboarding, Home, Progress, Settings), and habit list UI components.

classes.name: HabitWiseApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring MaterialApp with theme and initial route.

classes.name: OnboardingScreen
classes.description: Displays initial onboarding UI with a welcome message and 'Get Started' button.

classes.name: MainNavigationScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget managing bottom navigation between Home, Progress, and Settings screens.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen showing current habits list with a FloatingActionButton to add habits.

classes.name: HabitCardsList
classes.description: Displays a list of habit cards, each representing a habit with options to edit.

classes.name: HabitEditModal
classes.description: Modal sheet for adding or editing a habit, with input fields for name and goal.

classes.name: ProgressScreen
classes.description: Placeholder screen for displaying progress charts and analytics.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: Settings page with options like Offline Support and theme settings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the HabitWiseApp widget.

methods.name: _onTab
methods.description: Updates the selected tab index in MainNavigationScreen.
